setups.reasoning: reasoning off: every request sent reasoning_effort "none" (the lowest effort OpenRouter lists for this model on 2026-10-24); every response reported 0 reasoning tokens
setups.notes: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro through OpenRouter, pinned to Moonshot AI's standard endpoint (mxfp4) for every one of its 1,462 league decisions; never on our GPUs. Late entry to League 3 on 24 Oct 2026 (its two missing pairings were played on 27 Oct). Every request sent reasoning_effort "none"; all 1,933 responses reported 0 reasoning tokens and carried no reasoning text. The endpoint returned no token probabilities, so it answers with one letter. Prompts are billed at list price; a separate $30 budget cap applied to Kimi.
